The '''Rebel Alliance Badge of Valor''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] badge awarded by [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] to individuals who were an "''outstanding example of heroism and bravery.''"<ref name="SWG:RABoV" />

One such badge was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who served [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] dutifully during the [[Remembrance Day]] festivities,<ref name="SWG:RtsIO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Rescue the sixth Imperial Officer|Corellia}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> The Rebel successfully [[Rescue at Yavin 4|rescued]] six Alliance [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] from a a [[Detainment Facility]] in the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:Rt6AP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rescue the sixth Alliance Pilot|Yavin 4}}</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a similar award named [[Imperial Badge of Meritorious Service]].<ref name="SWG:IBoMS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Imperial Badge of Meritorious Service}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Alliance Badge of Valor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RABoV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Alliance Badge of Valor was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and could be obtained during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events<ref name="SWG:RABoV" /> in 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref>
